user.title: Cloudflare Workers AI
user.description: Connect a Cloudflare account to use Workers AI for speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

data_description.account_id: Cloudflare account ID, shown in the Cloudflare dashboard.
data_description.api_token: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permissions.
data_description.use_gateway: Route requests through Cloudflare AI Gateway.

data_description.gateway_token: Token for an authenticated AI Gateway. Leave empty for a gateway without authentication.

error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or lacks the required permissions.
error.gateway_id_required: The gateway ID is required when AI Gateway is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This Cloudflare account is already configured.
